Name: Minecart Master - Unlock Early and Set Operating Hours - Work with Integrated Minecarts
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[size=6][b][center]Minecart Master[/center][/b][/size][b][size=4][color=#ffff00]Compatible with[/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts - A Minecart Expansion[/url]﻿
[/size][/b][quote]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/quote]

Take full control of the minecart system in Stardew Valley! This mod allows you to unlock minecarts early, set operating hours, and even charge for travel.

[center]﻿[youtube]tObXBu26AaY[/youtube][/center]


[size=5][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[b]Early Unlock
[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock all minecarts immediately without completing the Boiler Room bundles
[/list][list]
[*] Perfect for new playthroughs or testing
[/list]
[b]Operating Hours
[/b]
[list]
[*] Enable Adaptive Mode to set when minecarts are available
[/list][list]
[*] Configure five time slots throughout the day:
[list]
[*] 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM
[*] 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
[*] 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
[*] 5:00 PM - 12:00 AM
[*] 12:00 AM - 2:00 AM
[/list][/list][list]
[*] When closed, players see a custom message explaining the system is unavailable
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41694/41694-1769483844-1938736097.png[/img]﻿
[b]Travel Cost
[/b]
[list]
[*] Set a gold cost for using the minecart system (default: free)
[/list][list]
[*] Players must have enough gold to travel
[/list][list]
[*] Adds an economic element to fast travel
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41694/41694-1769483821-1114373959.png[/img]

[size=5][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy in-game configuration. All settings can be adjusted without editing files:

[list]
[*] [b]Mod Enabled[/b] - Turn the mod on or off
[*] [b]Unlock All Minecarts[/b] - Bypass Boiler Room requirement
[*] [b]Adaptive Mode[/b] - Enable/disable operating hours
[*] [b]Travel Cost[/b] - Set gold cost per trip (0-10,000g)
[*] [b]Operating Hours[/b] - Check/uncheck each time slot
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41694/41694-1769483821-714850150.png[/img]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41694/41694-1769483821-869423801.png[/img]
[size=5][b]Requirements
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or higher
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for in-game config)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)
3. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
4. Run the game using SMAPI

[size=5][b]Usage
[/b][/size]
After installation, open the config menu (via GMCM or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]) to customize:

[b]Example Setup 1: Free Unlimited Access[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock All Minecarts: [b]ON[/b]
[*] Adaptive Mode: [b]OFF[/b]
[*] Travel Cost: [b]0g[/b]
[/list]
[b]Example Setup 2: Realistic Transit System
[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock All Minecarts: [b]OFF[/b] (complete Boiler Room normally)
[*] Adaptive Mode: [b]ON[/b]
[*] Operating Hours: 6am-12am only (overnight closed)
[*] Travel Cost: [b]50g[/b]
[/list]
[b]Example Setup 3: Late Game Convenience
[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock All Minecarts: [b]ON[/b]
[*] Adaptive Mode: [b]OFF[/b]
[*] Travel Cost: [b]100g[/b] (small fee for instant travel)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Works in single-player and multiplayer
[*] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*] No known conflicts with other mods
[/list]
